findings.post_fix_result: PASS: 1 file, 9 tests; final full backend also passed 156 files and 2010 tests.
findings.residual_boundary: No other Issue #112 file changed; the future correction/compensation workflow remains outside this slice.

findings.pre_fix_reproduction: New route RED expected 200 but received 400 because planBatchDeltas was called without locationId; the manual allocation payload also had no location. A second RED showed the non-batch pending path could not complete without manufacturing a batch.
findings.fix_path: Loaded and rechecked material batch policy, passed the explicit target location into the batch plan, used plan.allocations as the persisted fact source, and routed non-batch completion through planPositionAdditions with batch_id NULL.
findings.post_fix_command: TZ=UTC JWT_SECRET=<ephemeral> npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 tests/inventory-position-routes.test.ts tests/data-2-transaction-numeric-guards.test.ts tests/idempotency.test.ts tests/inventory-transaction-conservation.test.ts
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: 4 files, 32 tests; final route file contains 9 passing tests and final full backend passed 2010 tests.
findings.residual_boundary: Only legacy pending records are mutable to completed/cancelled; already completed receipts remain immutable without G2 compensation.

findings.pre_fix_reproduction: New route RED expected 409 but received 400: the obsolete inverse path happened to fail because the new planner required a location, rather than enforcing the frozen G2 product boundary.
findings.fix_path: Added an explicit completed-state COMPENSATION_CHAIN_REQUIRED boundary before idempotency replay and physically removed the old completed-inbound inverse mutation branch; pending-record deletion remains transactionally supported.
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: 2 files, 25 tests; assertions prove 409 plus unchanged record, cache, and positions for both cancel and delete.
findings.residual_boundary: A real append-only compensation event chain is a separate G2 delivery.

findings.post_fix_command: pis_test_jwt=$(openssl rand -base64 48) && TZ=UTC JWT_SECRET=$pis_test_jwt npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
findings.post_fix_result: PASS after both inbound fixes: exit 0; 156 files, 2010 tests, duration 217.42s. The earlier 2007/2007 run is not candidate evidence.
